newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa sees 96/97 profit above 95/96 rise.
newsitem.headline: Degussa sees 96/97 profit above 95/96 rise.

text.p: German chemicals, metals and drugs group Degussa AG said on Tuesday that profits in the 1996/1997 business year will likely outpace last year's rise but fall short of the first quarter's 20 percent jump.

Degussa chief financial officer Heinz-Joachim Wagner told Reuters Financial Television: "We expect a higher than two to three profit rise for the whole year but most probably this will be a little lower than the 20 percent rate."
The group earlier announced a 20 percent rise in group pre-tax profits after posting a two percent rise to 413 million marks ($254.7 million) in the 1995/1996 business year.
